text:
aj: quick question about generation API contract when stop sequences, max_tokens, and sampling params overlap. SDK tests are flapping, want to lock down concrete behavior.

riya: ok drop a minimal repro and we'll triage.

aj: repro below — using stop=[\"\n\n\"], max_tokens=5, temperature=0, top_p=0.8, logprobs=5.

```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-1",
  "prompt": "def foo():\n    return",
  "max_tokens": 5,
  "stop": ["\n\n"],
  "temperature": 0,
  "top_p": 0.8,
  "logprobs": 5
}
```

aj: observed behavior: returned text is truncated (stop text not present), finish_reason=\"stop\" when stop matched, token counts include stop tokens but choices[0].logprobs is missing the stop tokens. SDK expected no stop tokens included in counts. confusing.

mike: historically different runtimes handled stop token inclusion inconsistently. we should define: 1) whether stop tokens are included in tokens/logprobs 2) how finish_reason is signaled for stop vs max_tokens vs truncation.

sara: my proposal: 1) response text should NOT include stop sequences (keeps client-visible text clean). 2) if logprobs requested, include the raw emitted tokens up to and including tokens that matched the stop sequence (so clients can inspect probabilities for the exact stopping tokens). 3) finish_reason values like \"stop\", \"max_tokens\", \"length\" etc. 4) include a boolean \"truncated\" when max_tokens cut output before a stop was reached.

carla: nit: make \"truncated\" a boolean. name is fine.

riya: +1 to sara. note: including stop tokens in logprobs means SDKs must strip them when rebuilding text. also document that usage.total_tokens includes stop tokens.

mike: also: when temperature=0 and top_p!=1 are both set, treat temperature=0 as greedy and ignore top_p. emit a \"warnings\" array in the response so callers get an actionable hint instead of silent behavior changes.

aj: warn or error on contradictory sampling params? prefer warning to avoid breaking existing callers.

sara: agree warn not error. also add a runtime test to assert determinism for temperature=0.

carla: on logprobs with truncation: return logprobs for all emitted tokens. if we hit max_tokens before stop, finish_reason=\"max_tokens\" and truncated=true.

riya: two clarifications: 1) stop sequences that span multiple tokenizer tokens should appear as those tokens in the tokens array (we pass raw tokenizer output). 2) if stop and max_tokens coincide, prefer \"stop\" if the stop matched before honoring max_tokens, otherwise \"max_tokens\".

mike: test/SDK checklist for the patch: - server: add \"warnings\" array (string[]) in response metadata - server: ensure \"truncated\" boolean present for max_tokens truncation - server: include stop tokens in choices[*].logprobs.tokens but NOT in choices[*].text concatenation - docs: call out that usage.total_tokens includes stop tokens - SDK: add helper reconstruct_text(tokens, exclude_stop=True) and update tests

aj: @mike can you add server patch + unit tests? I'll pick up SDK changes after server stabilizes. link PR in thread.

mike: will open PR today, pinging @sara for API docs wording review.

sara: will review. propose docs example for warnings:

```
{
  "id": "gen-123",
  "choices": [{...}],
  "warnings": ["temperature=0 -> top_p ignored for deterministic sampling"]
}
```

carla: one more thought: add an opt-in per-request flag policy.strict_sampling=true so strict clients can get validation errors on contradictory params. low priority.

aj: final QA note: logprobs presence when finish_reason=stop — include logprobs up through stop tokens. SDK tests that assumed logprobs cut before stop will need updates.

riya: i'm updating internal test matrix and will post failing diffs in the PR comments.

deploy-bot: rollout note: this contract change behind feature flag \"contract-v2-sampling-warnings\"; coordinate with infra on canary schedule.

mike: noted, targeting canary next week.

aj: thanks all, I'll follow the PR and handle SDK changes post-server patch. :thumbsup:
